ClearHouse.live was a **collaborative winter project** built to make U.S. politicians' financial disclosures easier to search and understand.

## Site snapshot

[Open ClearHouse.live ↗](https://clearhouse.live)

ClearHouse turns politician stock trades from public disclosures into a searchable website. I worked across the data pipeline: collecting filings, extracting and cleaning transactions, storing the results, and connecting them to the web interface. The project informed my later House and Senate PTR pipelines.

**Stack:** Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, SQLite, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, and Chart.js.

:::
